stdout: PASS production fd-3 activation, root valid request, bad/extra/truncated framing, real non-root peer refusal, zero tokens and no credential creation
notes: Production broker compiled in disposable container from read-only source mounts; no FPC_AUTH_TESTING backend override.
Valid root request has absent UID state and returns ENOENT with 69 zero token bytes.
Non-root connector uses actual setgid/setuid 65534; socket permissions deliberately relaxed only inside the disposable container after daemon startup, testing SO_PEERCRED enforcement.
All state/socket files and processes are container-local; no phone, firmware, host state or authentication operations.
Harness explicitly clears fd 3 CLOEXEC after dup2 because source and destination can be identical.
